inputs.text: Her 2026 State of the State agenda would make gunmakers share responsibility for preventing weapons sold in New York from being easily converted into illegal machine guns. That matters: communities should not be left to absorb the harm when an industry could take foreseeable risks seriously. The proposal also includes criminal penalties, but the account doesn’t say who would face them—a detail that will matter for whether accountability reaches the industry or falls elsewhere.
